name: Russo-Georgian War
note: 7-12 Aug 2008; South Ossetian and Abkhaz forces fought alongside Russia. EU-mediated six-point ceasefire.

name: Djiboutian-Eritrean border conflict
note: Clashes 10-13 Jun 2008 at Ras Doumeira; Djibouti reported 44 own dead and ~100 Eritrean dead. Qatar-mediated agreement 6 Jun 2010.

name: Heglig Crisis (Sudan-South Sudan border war)
note: Mar-Sep 2012; South Sudan seized Heglig oilfield, withdrew 20 Apr 2012. Death claims range from 31/256 (South Sudanese) to 1,200 (Sudanese); no reliable total.

name: Russo-Ukrainian War: Crimea annexation and Donbas war
note: Crimea seized Feb-Mar 2014; Donbas war fought largely via Russian-backed DPR/LPR with direct Russian army involvement (e.g., Ilovaisk 2014, Debaltseve 2015). Merged into the full-scale invasion on 24 Feb 2022. Deaths ~14,000 (UN OHCHR 2014-2021 estimate, from prior knowledge; not re-fetched).

name: 2016 Nagorno-Karabakh clashes (Four-Day War)
note: 1-5 Apr 2016; US State Department estimate ~350 dead on both sides. Ceasefire agreed in Moscow 5 Apr 2016.

name: Operation Spring Shield (Turkey-Syria clashes in Idlib)
note: 27 Feb-6 Mar 2020; ~40 Turkish soldiers (33 in the Balyun airstrike) and 197-405 Syrian government/allied fighters killed (SOHR / MEI). Ended by Turkey-Russia Moscow ceasefire 5 Mar 2020.

name: Second Nagorno-Karabakh War
note: 27 Sep-10 Nov 2020 (44 days); official military deaths 3,825 Armenian/Artsakh and 2,906 Azerbaijani plus ~185 civilians. Turkey supported Azerbaijan; Syrian mercenaries also deployed.

name: Russian invasion of Ukraine
note: Full-scale war from 24 Feb 2022, ongoing as of Oct 2026 (local Oleshky ceasefire agreed 24 Oct 2026; talks planned Nov 2026). North Korean troops fought for Russia in Kursk 2024-25. CSIS (Jan 2026): up to 325,000 Russian and 140,000 Ukrainian military deaths Feb 2022-Dec 2025.

name: 2022 Kyrgyzstan-Tajikistan border war
note: Main fighting 14-20 Sep 2022 (earlier clashes Jan-Jun 2022); 83 Tajik and 63 Kyrgyz deaths reported. Border treaty signed 13 Mar 2025.

name: September 2022 Armenia-Azerbaijan clashes
note: 12-14 Sep 2022, Azerbaijani strikes into Armenia proper; ~204 Armenian servicemen and 80 Azerbaijani servicemen killed, plus civilians.

name: Rwanda-backed M23 offensive in eastern DR Congo
note: Rwandan Defence Force units operated alongside M23 (documented by UN experts); Goma fell Jan 2025, Bukavu Feb 2025. Deaths ~7,000 since Jan 2025 per DRC government claim (prior knowledge). Washington peace agreement 27 Jun 2025 and Washington Accords 4 Dec 2025; fighting continued (M23 took Uvira Dec 2025). Interstate status is contested (Rwanda denies direct combat role).

name: 2023 Azerbaijani offensive in Nagorno-Karabakh
note: 19-20 Sep 2023; 192 Azerbaijani and 200+ Artsakh soldiers killed. Armenia not a belligerent; Artsakh dissolved and nearly all Armenians left. Not strictly interstate (one side non-recognised).

name: Iran-Israel direct strikes of 2024
note: Iranian missile/drone attacks 13-14 Apr and 1 Oct 2024; Israeli strikes 19 Apr and 26 Oct 2024. Few deaths (several Iranian soldiers killed 26 Oct). From prior knowledge; not re-fetched (search budget exhausted).

name: 2025 India-Pakistan conflict (Operation Sindoor)
note: 7-10 May 2025; official tolls 29 Indian (21 civilians) and 53 Pakistani (40 civilians). Ceasefire agreed via DGMO hotline 10 May 2025.

name: Twelve-Day War (Israel-Iran war)
note: 13-24 Jun 2025; US struck Iranian nuclear sites 22 Jun. Iran 1,060-1,190 dead, Israel ~33. US-brokered ceasefire 24 Jun 2025.

name: Cambodia-Thailand border conflict (July 2025)
note: 24-28 Jul 2025; early official tolls ~16 Thai soldiers, 14 Thai civilians, 5 Cambodian soldiers, 8 Cambodian civilians (OSINT suggests higher Cambodian military losses). Malaysia-brokered Putrajaya ceasefire 28 Jul 2025.

name: October 2025 Afghanistan-Pakistan border clashes
note: ~9-19 Oct 2025; Pakistani strikes on Kabul/Kandahar and border fighting, dozens of troops and civilians killed (e.g., 40 civilians in Spin Boldak per local officials). No reliable total. 48-hour truce 15 Oct, Doha ceasefire 19 Oct 2025 (Qatar/Turkey).

name: Cambodia-Thailand border conflict (December 2025)
note: 8-27 Dec 2025; Thailand: 26 soldiers + 1 civilian in combat and 44 indirect civilian deaths; Cambodia: 30 civilians and 110+ soldiers/police (Nikkei count). Ceasefire signed by defence ministers 27 Dec 2025.

name: 2026 United States intervention in Venezuela
note: 3 Jan 2026 strikes and raid that captured Nicolas Maduro; ~80 dead (23-47 Venezuelan military, 32 Cuban personnel, civilians), no US deaths. A brief interstate armed clash rather than a sustained war; relations restored Mar 2026.

name: 2026 Afghanistan-Pakistan war
note: From 21 Feb 2026 ('open war' declared 27 Feb); Pakistan claimed ~800 Afghan Taliban/TTP fighters killed by 5 Apr 2026, Taliban claimed 400+ killed in a March strike on a Kabul rehab centre; figures unverified, total highly uncertain. Eid pause in March; front reported quiet after Chinese-hosted Urumqi talks mid-Apr 2026 with no settlement. end=null because no settlement is recorded and a search hit (FDD, dated 5 Oct 2026, unfetchable) suggests renewed Pakistani strikes in autumn 2026.

name: 2026 Iran war
note: From 28 Feb 2026 (US-Israeli strikes; Ali Khamenei killed). Gulf states listed as belligerents after Iranian strikes on their territory. Iran deaths 3,528-3,684 (Iranian govt/HRANA) to 6,000+ military (US/Israeli claim); all fronts incl. Israel-Hezbollah in Lebanon 8,000-10,600 (deaths_est = rough midpoint, all fronts). Ceasefire 8 Apr, Islamabad MoU 17 Jun, collapse 8 Jul 2026; as of Oct 2026 strikes largely halted but no deal and a US blockade continues. major=false is borderline: all-front estimates straddle 10,000 and only one side is a great power.
